labs.title: Foundations, files, Chat, and first saved note

checks.fresh-install: Fresh-cache locked core installation succeeds; on-create Copilot CLI and the Website preview helper verified separately; no Chromium or research dependency startup requirement
checks.access: GitHub and editor Chat work with the intended attendee account
checks.orientation: Concepts-only GitHub tour from the README, including an attendee-like account making a private copy of the template in agentic-dev-labs with Use this template, and the labelled visual guide checked in browser-based Codespaces before terminal use
checks.chat-turn: A real editor Chat request and refinement completed without terminal setup
checks.first-note: Separate 10:00 block: learner created and corrected a brief, saved, reviewed, committed, pushed, and read back the same branch on GitHub

checks.first-page: Actual /create-website invocation asks only which of the four websites, then builds the tested blueprint named after the repository; existing pages preserved; no finished template or installation exercise
checks.preview: Actual Website preview panel renders beside Chat, updates by itself on changes with added entries kept, and stop/start reopens the same saved page without file changes; blockers recorded truthfully
checks.manual-behaviour: Coached 11:45 block: expected-versus-observed manual button check, with real fixes rechecked
checks.source-check: Coached 11:45 block: the starter's count, or Weather against its raw forecast data, checked by the learner, not the model's confidence
checks.read-code: Chat explained selected lines of site/index.html, and the learner changed the <h1> headline by hand; the preview updated after saving and a broken edit was recoverable with Ctrl+Z

optional_checks.research-mcp: Selected optional browser and document tools actually invoked; installation alone is insufficient
optional_checks.browser-download: Playwright inspected the official archive and at least one actual PDF download and reporting year; remaining years and blockers recorded truthfully
optional_checks.conversion: A real MarkItDown conversion inspected; complete file output retained and any CLI fallback or truncation distinguished from MCP success
optional_checks.facts: Comparable facts checked against original public sources with years, units, locations, calculations, and live/prepared labels
optional_checks.visual-brief: Optional visual-brief invoked with verified facts without overwriting the learner's site; charts, references, navigation, and layout checked

checks.implementation: One meaningful interaction implemented in the existing page with fictional input and safe text handling
checks.personalisation: Chosen Project Planner, Calendar, Ideas Wall, Weather, Princeton Map, Photo Studio, or own-idea page gets one visual improvement and one feature improvement through ordinary Chat, without repeating creation or switching frameworks; actual diff and page inspected
checks.manual-checks: Manual add/remove or equivalent journey, empty input, keyboard access, and narrow layout checked honestly
checks.preview: Learner reopened the private preview and recorded actual results and remaining limitations
checks.undo: A deliberately bold Copilot change was reverted with Chat's Undo and the page returned to its previous state

optional_checks.storage: If selected, add/reload/present/remove/reload observed in one browser; corrupt or unavailable storage handled without clearing other apps' data
optional_checks.sketch: Optional: docs/images/sketch-example.png attached to Chat and the page restyled toward it with entries and features kept; a model without image input recorded as blocked, not passed
optional_checks.ai-picture: Optional: a picture drawn by the workshop helper was placed in the page from a plain Chat request; a Codespace without the secrets recorded as blocked, not passed

checks.reviewed-files: Selected changes and site assets exclude private material, credentials, full reports, and unrelated changes
checks.reviewed-commit: Reviewed work pushed and read back on the intended GitHub branch through the beginner workflow
checks.checked-feature: Private preview still works after the last improvement; learner explains an actual check and limitation
checks.no-azure-login: No attendee Azure login or credential creation used; publication is not required for Monday
checks.github-tour: Commit message generated with the sparkle icon and corrected, pushed, and the commit list, one commit's changes, and the History of site/index.html found on GitHub

optional_checks.actions: Deploy workflow succeeded for that commit using the prepared runner identity
optional_checks.endpoint: Website-target artifact and fresh responses match the exact commit, label, entry-page bytes, and site fingerprint; no vendor-app substitution
optional_checks.deployed-behaviour: Chosen interaction verified at the actual new deployment URL, not just the health endpoint
optional_checks.deployed-storage: Only if storage was selected, its journey repeated at the deployment origin without assuming preview state transfers
optional_checks.challenge: A bronze, silver, or gold challenge-card level completed and checked by the learner
optional_checks.add-chat: Optional bonus: /add-chat added the Ask bubble and one answer was checked against the page

checks.idea-brief: Participant chose an own idea or the default, described one user outcome and check, and used the /create-website own-idea route in site/ideas/ without overwriting Monday's work
checks.prototype: A bounded prototype or improved default works with fictional app-local content; no service integration or account migration was required
checks.manual-journey: Expected versus observed user journey, input handling, and one useful improvement checked manually
checks.saved-work: Reviewed changes committed, pushed, and read back from the intended GitHub branch
checks.handover: Working features and unresolved data/access/approval questions recorded for the technical owner; no training membership or personal account deleted

labs.title: VS Code and a User Requirements agent

checks.cli-turn: Actual Codespaces Copilot CLI sign-in with /login and the device code, and a question about the learner's own page compared with the page
checks.requirements-agent: Learner-described .github/agents/user-requirements.agent.md written by Copilot CLI, edited by the learner, and listed by /agent after a CLI restart
checks.stories: Requirements file next to the brief with numbered user stories and Given/When/Then criteria; one story validated and marked Approved
checks.story-built: The approved story implemented on the learner's page; every criterion checked by hand in the Website preview, with one debug round recorded truthfully
checks.tests: Learner tests in checks/test_*.py written with checks/website.py; pytest checks shown green, red after a deliberate break, and green again; build and run commands written in the brief
checks.checkpoint: Agent, requirements, page and tests reviewed, committed, pushed, and read back on GitHub

optional_checks.vscode-agent: The same agent file chosen in VS Code Chat's agent picker and its answer compared with Copilot CLI
optional_checks.github-mcp: Optional Lab 04: read-only GitHub MCP started, no write tools, recent commits matched GitHub
optional_checks.teach-copilot: Optional Lab 06: instructions file, learner make-image skill, and /add-chat with the FOUNDRY_* workshop identity
optional_checks.browser-demo: Optional presenter browser-tools demonstration rehearsed in the presenter's Codespace

labs.title: GitHub Copilot cloud agents and a Code Review agent

checks.branch-pr: A practice branch created in the Codespace, published, opened as a pull request, merged, deleted, and pulled back into main
checks.review-agent: Learner-described .github/agents/code-review.agent.md with review rules and the findings-table report format, listed by /agent
checks.report: reviews/pr-N.md written by the review agent for Copilot's pull request; every finding marked Confirmed or Not a problem by the learner with a reason
checks.iteration: An @copilot comment on a confirmed finding produced a new commit; the criterion, pytest checks, and a second review were rerun; a neighbour checked one criterion
checks.decision: The pull request merged (or closed with a reason), main pulled, the change checked in the preview, and the agent and report pushed

optional_checks.publication: Optional Lab 08 website publication verified at the actual URL for the exact commit

labs.title: Delegate an approved story to the cloud agent

checks.issue-session: An approved story with acceptance criteria filed with the User story for Copilot template, assigned to the actual cloud agent, with its session inspected
checks.review: The draft pull request's diff compared with the story; scope limited to the requested file
checks.merged-check: Merged change pulled into the Codespace and checked in the Website preview

optional_checks.website-change: The simpler Website change for Copilot template used for a non-story change

checks.workflow: Starter copied to .github/workflows/check-my-website.yml from the Codespace, pull_request and push triggers added, contents permission reduced to read, and a green run
checks.ci: A pull request whose check went red from a deliberate break, its log read (and explained by Copilot CLI), fixed to green, and merged
checks.cd: Approval starter in place, the learner a required reviewer of the training environment, and a release published only after Review deployments > Approve
checks.recovery: scripts/smoke_test.py passed, failed on a deliberately bad headline, and passed again after a revert, with the content fingerprint back to the known-good value
checks.demos: Team demo of requirements, a verified review finding, and CI/CD evidence rehearsed in the actual room setup
checks.handoff: HANDOFF.md naming the agents, pipeline steps, release and rollback, and release owner pushed to GitHub

optional_checks.smoke-in-pipeline: Optional smoke-test step added to the publishing workflow
